test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Those verses are collectively known as the Bhagavadgita.

B. His hesitation before the battle against his family became the occasion for his friend and charioteer, Lord Krishna, to deliver a discourse on dharma.

C. Arjuna was one of the five Pandava brothers, who are the heroes of the Indian epic, the 'Mahabharata'.

D. He was the son of the god Indra and was famous for his archery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **CDBA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence C** introduces the main character, Arjuna, and his background.
 
• **Sentence D** provides additional information about Arjuna, specifically about his skills and heritage.
 
• **Sentence B** explains the context of the discourse delivered by Lord Krishna.
 
• **Sentence A** concludes the paragraph by identifying the discourse as the Bhagavadgita.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.
